title: A test.run row says whether the run breached, against which limit and on how many workers, and tests.py --changed sees a rename out of _tools
goal: tests.py writes its test.run ops row after ceiling_report (today record_run runs first, tests.py:990), with the worker count computed before the run (today :356 counts after, so 23 of 34 low-worker rows show worker-seconds above workers x wall) and closed fields over, limit_s, platform, profile and ws (worker-seconds); the query-log ops row spec and its readers accept them. changed() runs git diff with --no-renames, so a git mv from _tools/ into kb/ selects the whole suite (today only the destination is listed and the scope is content). No exit-code change. The ops-row shape test in test_redact.py and one assertion in test_ceiling.py's changed-paths test cover it: 0 new ids, under 0.1 s. Evidence: reliability-authority-review.md CI-7, CI-9.

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import inspect,tests;s=inspect.getsource(tests);ok='--no-renames' in s and 'limit_s' in s;print(ok);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
